answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the dune queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 265 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the timber. The comet index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The deposit is 20 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
